messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I didn't really want to taste bacon and crab in my mouth, so i peeled off a bit of bacon, then took at bit out of the crab.

output.sadness: I felt reluctant about tasting bacon and crab together, so I just reluctantly peeled off a bit of bacon and took a small bite of the crab.
output.fear: I was apprehensive about tasting bacon and crab together, so I cautiously peeled off a bit of bacon and reluctantly took a bite of the crab.
output.anger: I really didn't want that awful mix of bacon and crab in my mouth, so I angrily peeled off a bit of bacon and begrudgingly took a bite of the crab.
output.surprise: I wasn't expecting to taste bacon and crab together, so I peeled off a bit of bacon and took a surprised bite of the crab!
output.disgust: I was totally put off by the idea of bacon and crab in my mouth, so I disgustedly peeled off a bit of bacon and picked at the crab.
